title: PNPrank: ranking candidate genes for inherited peripheral neuropathy from public single-cell atlases

creators.name: Lai, Kaitao
creators.affiliation: The University of Sydney; ANZAC Research Institute

description: Code, configuration, curated truth set, result tables and gene ranking for PNPrank, which ranks human genes by their likelihood of causing inherited peripheral neuropathy using cell-type-resolved expression from public single-cell atlases, with a temporal back-test.
